hints.title: Prioritize Higher Point Pattern
hints.text: Always greedily remove occurrences of the higher scoring substring first.

hints.title: Two-Pass Stack Removal
hints.text: Use a linear stack scan to eliminate the primary substring, then a second pass on leftover characters for secondary.

hints.title: Tally Total Points
hints.text: Multiply count of first matches by higher score and second matches by lower score.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively searching and splicing substrings takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two sequential stack passes process the string in linear O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves greedy prioritization of higher-value pair does not compromise global optimum.
